# GR-01 Re-review 1 — H1 MSP Promotion Readiness

**Review date:** 2026-08-10
**Reviewer:** Independent read-only re-reviewer
**Review target:** `GR-01-h1-readiness.md` after fix cycle 1
**Status:** COMPLETE

**Verdict: `FAIL`** — F-01 (code-claim provenance) and F-03 (same-target evidence) are
corrected, but F-02 remains incorrectly resolved. The report calls the missing `version` on an
`architecture_decision` update a Phase 2 contract defect even though the contract does not
require that field for this note type. The H1 writer verdict `NEEDS_REVISION` may remain for
the documented code-provenance warnings, unresolved two-update target ordering, and the need
for a human-reviewable final ADR result; it must not rely on an invented version requirement.

## Review boundary

Read-only review of the current report against the GR-01 brief, prior review, L0 atomic index,
both Visual Office inbound proposals, the separately pending ADR-068 inbound envelope,
canonical ADR-068, the Phase 2 contract, H1/EV-GOV-001 plan evidence, the canonical-only MSP
validator, and the current permission/authentication implementation. No proposal, canonical
file, index, script, code, schema, Git state, or previous report was changed.

## Required correction

### R1 — Correct the contract semantics for versioning (hard gate)

**Report locations:** `GR-01-h1-readiness.md` lines 55, 57-58, 68-70, and 141-143.

The current report conflates two different contract rules. For this `architecture_decision`,
the amendment's missing `version` is not a conditional-field failure. Nor does
`no_invented_versions` prescribe that an `update_atomic` payload must supply a new version; it
only constrains any version change to a SemVer increment. The contract also defines
`update_atomic` only as “modify existing file” and provides no patch/inheritance/merge
representation (`phase2_atomic_contract.yaml` lines 146-161). The canonical-only validator
does not supply those semantics (`scripts/msp/validate-atomic-ids.mjs` lines 9-11 and 34-38).

**Required report change:** Replace “nonconformant” and “fails the update-version rule” with an
accurate, bounded statement: no candidate update version is supplied, so this particular
proposal cannot demonstrate a SemVer increment; the contract does not itself require one for
an ADR. Keep the separate readiness requirement that a human/MSP reviewer must order the two
same-target updates and approve a complete resulting ADR without data loss. If the final
canonical ADR changes its version, that selected value must be a valid SemVer increment from
the canonical baseline then in force.

| 1. Completeness | **FAIL** | The report has the previously missing provenance row and target-field evidence, but its exact metadata/anti-hallucination result is still materially wrong for the ADR version field. This prevents a complete contract assessment. |
| 2. Requirement traceability | **PASS** | H1 and `EV-GOV-001` are correctly tied to MSP acceptance plus atomic-index proof (`docs/implementation-plan.md` lines 308-316 and 485-490). The same-target blocker is now traceable to both envelope target fields. |
| 3. Internal consistency | **FAIL** | The conditional-fields row says only `context_anchor.duration` and `epistemic.confidence` apply to the ADR (report line 48), then the update-semver row treats the absent, non-required version as nonconformant (line 55). The result needs the distinction described in R1. |
| 4. Standards compliance | **WARN** | The report remains structurally clear and bounded, but it has no minimal document-control metadata (version, review date, reviewer, and status). This is not the H1 blocker. |
| 5. Code alignment | **PASS** | Current code supports the report’s retained observations: `ownership` exists for every role; `OWNER` and `DEV` have `F`; `W` normalizes to `F` (`src/lib/permissionMatrix.js` lines 50-59 and 83-91). Presentation mode dispatches the handler before session validation and domain RBAC (`src/lib/auth.js` lines 185-188). The focused permission suite passed: 3 files, 106 tests. |
| 6. Writing quality | **PASS** | The revised report is readable, concrete, and preserves the H1 non-action boundary. No diagram is needed for this gate assessment. |

## Retained gate position

`NEEDS_REVISION` is still a supportable H1 writer outcome after R1 is corrected: neither
proposal has a clean provenance-warning disposition, the exact shared target needs human/MSP
ordering or reconciliation, the contract offers no deterministic inbound update merge process,
and `EV-GOV-001` is unavailable until MSP acceptance and canonical-index proof. This
re-review does not authorize promotion, indexing, code work, or any capability change.
